name: Bvr World REMASTERED
summary:
Welcome back to the world of BrassVR—built bigger, smoother, and better than ever before! Bvr World Remastered is the definitive multiplayer social platformer where you throw away the controllers' joysticks and use your real arms to conquer the environment.
